# 站会、回顾与评审

## 概述

本章围绕敏捷团队的例行会议组织英语词汇，分为每日站会、Sprint 回顾、Sprint 评审、跨团队评审四个部分。它帮助读者在这些会议中用英语汇报进展、讨论问题和总结成果，重点是会议中常见动作的表达。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合日常会议与会议记录。建议把站会类高频表达与回顾、评审术语结合学习，形成完整的会议应对能力。

## 每日站会 (Daily Standup)

| 词汇                     | 词性  | 含义           | 常用搭配                            |
| ------------------------ | ----- | -------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| standup                  | n.    | 站会           | daily standup, standup format       |
| update                   | n.    | 进展更新       | give an update, quick update        |
| blocker                  | n.    | 阻断问题       | raise a blocker, blocker resolution |
| progress                 | n.    | 进展           | report progress, good progress      |
| yesterday/today/blockers | n.    | 昨天/今天/阻碍 | standup format: Y/T/B               |
| timebox                  | v./n. | 时间限制       | timebox the meeting, strict timebox |

### 听说例句

> A: Let's keep the standup timeboxed to 15 minutes. What's your update? B: Yesterday I finished the API integration. Today I'm working on the unit tests. No blockers.

> A: I have a blocker — the design spec isn't finalized. B: I'll sync with the designer after standup and get it resolved by end of day.

### 写作表达

- The daily standup follows the yesterday/today/blockers format with a strict 15-minute timebox.
- Blockers raised during standup are immediately assigned an owner for resolution within the same day.

---

## Sprint 回顾 (Retrospective)

| 词汇            | 词性 | 含义     | 常用搭配                                  |
| --------------- | ---- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| retrospective   | n.   | 回顾会   | sprint retro, hold a retrospective        |
| what went well  | n.   | 做得好的 | discuss what went well, positive feedback |
| what to improve | n.   | 待改进的 | identify improvements, improvement action |
| action item     | n.   | 行动项   | assign action items, follow through       |
| velocity        | n.   | 速度     | sprint velocity, track velocity           |
| burndown        | n.   | 燃尽图   | burndown chart, burndown trend            |

### 听说例句

> A: In the retro, what went well this sprint? B: We improved our velocity by 20%. The burndown chart shows steady progress with no late-sprint rush.

> A: What should we improve? B: Code review turnaround was too slow. Let's add an action item to set a 24-hour SLA for reviews.

### 写作表达

- The retrospective identified three areas for improvement, each with assigned action items and owners.
- Sprint velocity has steadily increased over the past four cycles, as reflected in the burndown chart trends.

---

## Sprint 评审 (Sprint Review)

| 词汇       | 词性  | 含义   | 常用搭配                                    |
| ---------- | ----- | ------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| demo       | n./v. | 演示   | sprint demo, demo the feature               |
| showcase   | v.    | 展示   | showcase progress, showcase to stakeholders |
| feedback   | n.    | 反馈   | gather feedback, stakeholder feedback       |
| increment  | n.    | 增量   | product increment, shippable increment      |
| acceptance | n.    | 验收   | acceptance testing, acceptance criteria met |
| next steps | n.    | 下一步 | discuss next steps, plan next steps         |

### 听说例句

> A: Are we ready for the sprint demo? B: Yes, I'll showcase the new checkout flow. It meets all acceptance criteria and is a shippable increment.

> A: What feedback did stakeholders give? B: They loved the UX improvement but suggested adding a confirmation step. I'll add it to the next steps.

### 写作表达

- The sprint review demo showcased a fully functional product increment that met all defined acceptance criteria.
- Stakeholder feedback from the review was documented and incorporated into the next sprint's planning.

---

## 跨团队评审

| 词汇                | 词性 | 含义       | 常用搭配                                        |
| ------------------- | ---- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| architecture review | n.   | 架构评审   | schedule architecture review, cross-team review |
| design critique     | n.   | 设计评审   | design critique session, constructive critique  |
| knowledge sharing   | n.   | 知识分享   | knowledge sharing session, tech talk            |
| brown bag           | n.   | 午餐学习会 | brown bag session, host a brown bag             |
| best practice       | n.   | 最佳实践   | share best practices, adopt best practices      |
| cross-pollination   | n.   | 跨团队学习 | encourage cross-pollination, idea exchange      |

### 听说例句

> A: Should we host a brown bag session on the new observability stack? B: Great idea. Knowledge sharing across teams is important for cross-pollination of ideas.

> A: The architecture review raised some concerns about scalability. B: Let me update the design doc. We should also share the best practices from the infra team.

### 写作表达

- Regular architecture reviews and design critiques foster knowledge sharing and ensure consistent quality standards.
- Brown bag sessions and cross-pollination activities build a culture of continuous learning across the engineering organization.
